column1: # Reference words: labels that make a number a business number, not personal data
# (order, invoice, payment reference ...). One entry per line, `#` comments, blank lines
# ignored; format in pl/references.tsv. A trailing `*` lets the word take suffixes
# (`factuur*`: `factuurnummer`, `factuurdatum`), a trailing `.` matches with or without the
# dot (`klantnr`/`klantnr.`). The shared check accepts "nummer" and "nr" between the label
# and the number, so `factuur nr. 123` needs no entry of its own.
# Every entry is scoped to the rules check for now: the NER check's negative words are pinned
# to the built-in list (tests/detect/test_reference_packs.py, LAB-1788), so a Dutch label
# does not drop an NER number yet.
